security.data_classification: PII + Financial — income, employment, expenditure data
security.access_control: Authenticated customer session; SCA required for application submission
security.audit: Application submission with SECCI acknowledgement timestamp logged immutably

per_phase_nfrs.availability: 99.5% — assessment delays extend the customer journey but do not cause data loss

security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — credit score, risk band (internal only)
security.access_control: Credit score not exposed to customer. Risk band restricted to internal systems.
security.audit: Credit bureau search logged with timestamp and bureau reference (ICO right to explanation)

security.data_classification: Highly Confidential — legally binding credit agreement
security.access_control: SCA required for agreement signing. SCA assertion reference stored as proof of electronic signature.
security.audit: Agreement execution with SCA assertion_ref logged immutably — legal evidence

security.access_control: Disbursement initiated by system process post-agreement execution — no further customer action required

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Consumer Credit Record Retention
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: LoanApplication, LoanAgreement, and LoanAccount records retained for minimum 6 years after settlement (CCA 1974 / FCA CONC). Credit agreement document retained in its executed form.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: CCA 1974 limitation period; FCA regulatory audit requirements.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: UK GDPR Article 22 — Automated Decision Disclosure
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: If application is declined by automated processing, the customer must be informed that the decision was automated, the main factors, and their right to request human review.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: UK GDPR Article 22 mandatory disclosure for automated credit decisions.

cross_cutting_nfrs.name: Hard Credit Search — One Per Application
cross_cutting_nfrs.requirement: Exactly one hard credit bureau search per confirmed application. No hard searches during product browsing or indicative quote phase.
cross_cutting_nfrs.rationale: Multiple hard searches damage customer credit file and violate Consumer Duty principle of not causing foreseeable harm.

regulatory_slas.name: CONC — Pre-Contractual Information (SECCI)
regulatory_slas.requirement: SECCI form must be provided before the customer submits the loan application
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Regulated credit agreement may be unenforceable; FCA fine

regulatory_slas.name: CCA 1974 — 14-Day Withdrawal Right
regulatory_slas.requirement: Customer has 14 calendar days from agreement execution to withdraw without reason
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Agreement unenforceable; FCA fine; criminal liability

regulatory_slas.name: CONC — Affordability Assessment
regulatory_slas.requirement: Creditworthiness and affordability assessment required before granting credit
regulatory_slas.breach_consequence: Irresponsible lending finding; potential for loan write-off; FCA fine
